answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each identity posts a 40-unit bond, unlocked only after 20 epochs of work matching its fingerprint of timing and task mix. A pearl of real history forms slowly and resists bulk faking. Minting 100 fake identities costs 100x40 = 4,000 units, and each fake must mimic a distinct plume of activity or be flagged. An atlas of public fingerprints lets peers check newcomers. Honest agents pay once and keep their bond.
